Name: (CP) 3frogs Baba Yaga for 1.6
Author: Meggiee
Description:
I have converted (with permission) 3frogs's cute Baba Yaga mod to Content Patcher, since BFAV is now obsolete.
All credits go to @3frogs for the original mod and art. The original version had no drops, so I decided to make a slight change and have these Baba Yaga drop Bone Fragments and Frozen Tears, to align a bit with the folklore.
To install, simply make sure you have both SMAPI and Content Patcher updated, then drop the unzipped mod into your Mods folder.

Manifest.Name: Paritee's Baba Yaga
Manifest.Description: Adds Baba Yaga for your coop.
